note: The family client scale: ONE source for both browser halves (W2/W5/W6/W10/W20, G2).
Both client packages receive a GENERATED tokens.ts with identical bytes; verify-client-tokens.mjs
fails the gate when either copy drifts from this file. Browser halves cannot import evolution-core
(every @deepseek-ai/* specifier is external in build-client.mjs), so the scale is generated into the
packages rather than shared at runtime.
radius.control = 8px WAS the platform’s own field radius on the 0.1.5 line (a literal border-radius:8px
in packages/client/ui-primitives/src/Input.module.css and the plugins-settings stylesheet). The 0.2.x
line moved both to the theme token: packages/client/ui-primitives/src/Input.module.css:8 is now
border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-md), and packages/client/ui-theme/src/styles/base.css:18 defines that
token as 12px — so the platform field radius is 12px while this token is still 8px (settings-ui’s
6px was the original outlier; unifying it was W6). Following the platform’s new radius is G2’s
decision, taken with the client seam that renders these panels; recorded here so it is a decision and
not drift.
hairline = .5px is the hairline width both surfaces already used.
measure.read = 80ch is the single reading measure (≈ 40em, ≈ 40 CJK glyphs at the panel type size).
G0.2 settled one value, not a wide/narrow pair (§15.4).
leading.base = 1.5 is what both surfaces already use; the reading face’s own leading is decided in G4
against a screenshot, from this same token.
cap.* are the container limits that remain: the list column (280px) and the source view’s scroll
cap (260px, the platform command card’s own metric). The preview’s 420px cap is GONE with W20 —
a document is read by scrolling the pane, not through a window inside it.
No entry here is speculative: every value is in use in one of the two stylesheets, or is the
platform value that replaces the outlier (radius.control).

lg.why: the panel title and the settings card title today

body.why: body text; the settings card rooted this in --dsh-content-font-size (W5)

sm.why: the panel root size, group headings, and the card’s 13px labels

xs.why: the card’s 12px hints, counts and errors

surface.why: the panel’s code block and preview cards, from the platform command card

pill.why: the capsule; a state, not a control

width.why: the hairline both surfaces draw; the LEVEL stays a platform alias (l1 container / l2 structure)

marker.why: the tinted edge of one rendered diff block

read.why: the reading measure of the document face (G4)

base.why: the line height both surfaces already use

primary.why: the one key that writes, or the field a card was overridden in

success.why: added text, a write that landed

ring.why: the platform sidebar row’s inset ring; one definition, both faces

block.why: the source view’s scroll cap, from the platform command card
